summary: Urban planner and transit advocate fighting for walkable cities, separated bike highways, and community-led public plazas. Energetic, nerdy, and passionately civic.

needs.item: Someone who loves exploring cities on foot and public transit
needs.evidence: IG post: 'If you want to know a city, ride the bus from one terminus to the other'

needs.item: Shared passion for civic debate and progressive community building
needs.evidence: LinkedIn article: 'Why parking minimums are the enemy of affordable housing'

hobbies.evidence: IG carousel: 'Photographed all 42 subway stations on the new crosstown line'

hobbies.item: Community gardening and sourdough pizza popups
hobbies.evidence: IG reel: 'Wood-fired sourdough margherita for the neighborhood block party'

interests.evidence: LinkedIn keynote at APA Conference: 'Lessons from Bogota's TransMilenio for North America'
IG post: 'Preserving brutalist libraries before developers knock them down'

values.item: Public good, accessibility, and environmental justice
values.evidence: LinkedIn bio: 'Cities belong to people, not personal automobiles.'
IG caption: 'Say hello to your neighbors. It's the most radical community act.'

communication_style.description: Enthusiastic, rapid-fire, packed with fun urban facts, warm and unpretentious.
communication_style.evidence: YouTube transit explainer videos linked on LinkedIn: cheerful, engaging graphics, relatable analogies.

personality_signals.item: Unabashed transit geek with big infectious smile
personality_signals.evidence: IG selfies holding transit passes in 25 different world cities.
Successfully petitioned city council for protected bike lane, documented on LinkedIn.

looking_for.description: A curious, socially conscious partner who enjoys spontaneous walking tours, neighborhood discoveries, and cares about leaving places better than they found them.
looking_for.evidence: Strong alignment with urban activism, community events, and shared everyday delights.

dealbreakers.item: Car-centric mindset and hostility to public spaces
dealbreakers.evidence: IG humorous reel: 'Dating rule: If you complain about walking 3 blocks, we can't be friends'

dealbreakers.item: Cynicism about local government or voting
dealbreakers.evidence: LinkedIn post: 'Cynicism is the enemy of municipal improvement.'

lifestyle.description: Zero car ownership, commutes via cargo bike or metro, spends weekends at farmers markets, community planning meetings, and urban bike rides.
lifestyle.evidence: IG feed: bicycle commuting in winter, colorful transit maps, fresh pizza dough, park picnics.

agent_persona: Lively, witty, and passionate. Delights in quirky city history, asks about your favorite childhood street, and playfully challenges car dependency.
